title: Trace one housing issue to documents and appropriate help

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: A housing document states contractual wording; whether a term is lawful or enforceable requires the actual jurisdiction and circumstances. A factual maintenance record can be prepared without making that legal determination.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Entire fictional agreement extract: report nonemergency fixture problems through the manager’s written portal; keep a copy and access reference; manager will acknowledge within two working days. This is a training stipulation, not law. Problem: a cupboard door handle has been loose since Monday; no injury, emergency or structural damage is reported. Today Tuesday. Resident may report but has no supplied repair permission. No rent-withholding or legal remedy term exists.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: Draft the dated factual request, identify the response point and prepare a question for an appropriate local housing-information service if the issue remains unresolved.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A sample lease says a repair fee applies. Can a learner conclude the term is legally enforceable everywhere?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: Report the loose handle and practical difficulty, request inspection and retain the copy/reference. Later fiction: portal receipt arrives Tuesday, no acknowledgment by Thursday; use the stated follow-up route and seek applicable local information rather than inventing a legal breach or remedy. Partial: report without date or record. Incorrect: withhold payment or self-authorize repair from this excerpt.
criteria: Document terms and law are separated
The request uses concrete dated facts

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: No. Distinguish the wording from legal validity; check actual jurisdiction, housing arrangement and appropriate qualified/public guidance. A sample contract cannot establish universal rights or obligations.
